headline_cluster.headline: IDF publishes evidence linking 170 Gaza journalists to Hamas, Islamic Jihad, after extensive documents recovered from Gaza
צה"ל חשף: 170 "עיתונאים" שנהרגו בעזה - היו מחבלים
צה"ל חושף: 170 מה"עיתונאים" שנהרגו בעזה - מחבלים | השמות והתפקידים

primary_source_search_status: located_via_secondary_corroboration: Primary source is the IDF Spokesperson's Unit release of Thu 2026-10-01 (statement by IDF Spokesperson Brig. Gen. Effie Defrin) plus a dedicated IDF site 'The Press Files' on idf.il listing names, photos, affiliations, roles and evidence. The site and IDF release could not be fetched (WebFetch egress-blocked in sandbox); figures reconstructed from consistent snippets across multiple independent re-reports (Times of Israel, JNS, ynetnews, JPost, Algemeiner, Jewish Insider, Haaretz headline, Ch.13, Israel Hayom, Ch.14, Makor Rishon, i24 HE). IDF-stated figures: 170 killed Gazans presented as journalists/media workers; 118 Hamas military wing, 49 PIJ, 2 Popular Resistance Committees, 1 Mujahideen Brigades (sum 170; the 1-person group is garbled in some Hebrew snippets, English sources consistently say Mujahideen Brigades); 17 said to have participated in Oct 7 2023; some said to have worked for/contributed to Reuters, CNN, BBC, AFP, AP, Le Monde, ABC Australia; evidence = images/documents produced by the terror organizations, some recovered in Gaza. All affiliation figures are the IDF's own characterization, not independently verified; CPJ had in June 2026 removed 8 names from its list for established Hamas links (list then 209).
clustering_note: Cross-outlet (i24/walla/ynet) same-day coverage of an IDF publication naming 170 Gaza-based journalists/media workers it says were Hamas/Islamic Jihad operatives, based on documents recovered in Gaza.
